title: Recurrence for even generalized binomial coefficients
statement: For every real number $s$ and natural number $k$, the generalized binomial coefficients satisfy $\binom{s}{2(k+1)}=\binom{s}{2k}(s-2k)(s-(2k+1))/((2k+1)(2k+2))$.
replaced: Let $s\in\bbr$ and $k\in\mathbb N$, the generalized binomial coefficients satisfy $\binom{s}{2k+2}=\binom{s}{2k}(s-2k)(s-2k-1)/((2k+1)(2k+2))$.
